description: Tier-1 self-authored Figma fixtures for the dashscene importer (see specs/SCOPE_DECISIONS.md §8). Each entry maps a fixture name to the Figma file key of a file authored in the project's own account. The capture tooling fetches GET /files/:fileKey?plugin_data=shared (§11, §12) and commits the returned JSON into corpus/figma-fixtures/<name>.json for offline record-and-replay (DESIGN §6.1).
provenance: self-authored via the fixture-author dev plugin (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author); Community-license-safe because nothing captured here is a third-party file (§8).

captureParams.note: ?plugin_data=shared is always passed so sharedPluginData roles (§12) round-trip even though no fixture carries them yet.

fixtures.name: v03-paint
fixtures.covers: v0.3 paint vocabulary under fixed layout (layoutMode NONE): solid fill, all four gradient kinds (linear/radial/angular/diamond), an image fill with a scale mode, the three stroke aligns (inside/center/outside), uniform and per-corner corner radii, and a clipsContent frame with an overflowing child
fixtures.note: Authored with the fixture-author plugin's v03-paint command (importers/figma/plugin/fixture-author/README.md). Designated input for the Figma REST lowering (#139) and the Deno importer (#17).

fixtures.note: designated input for token-resolution phase 1 (sidecar) and phase 2 (id->name join), §13
